看答案走势逐渐出现，再比较你和三个基线的误差。按 N 进入下一关。循序闯关按固定: Watch the actual curve appear, then compare your error with the three baselines. Press N to move on. Practice levels follow a fixed order from easy to hard. You can continue without winning.
默认先玩 8 个教学情境：规则周期 → 早晚双峰 → 缓慢上移 → 天气变化 →: Start with 8 practice scenarios: repeating cycles → morning and evening peaks → a rising trend → weather changes → combined clues. The first two levels teach you to copy a pattern. Repeat yesterday may be exact, so you do not need to beat it. Use the level buttons to revisit or jump ahead. Your progress survives a page refresh.
情报中的天气预报、离家安排都是明确标注的模拟设定，曲线按该设定生成。玩家能读情报: Weather forecasts and outing plans are clearly labelled simulation settings, and the curves are generated from them. You can read the clues; the three baselines only see the historical curve. This is not a model evaluation with equal information. After practice, try 18 windows of real UCI data.
每个预测都对照同一组 24 个实际值。平均绝对误差 MAE = 每小时预测与实际: Every forecast is compared with the same 24 actual values. Mean absolute error (MAE) is the sum of the absolute hourly forecast errors ÷ 24, measured in kW. Lower is better. Ties share a rank. A win means scoring strictly better than all three baselines.
你的画线会按小时线性插值。每段数据只记录第一次挑战成绩，成绩仅保存在此浏览器。揭: Your drawing is linearly interpolated at hourly intervals. Only your first attempt at each window counts, and scores are stored in this browser only. Before the reveal, the vertical scale is determined by history alone.
「日常节律」「波动挑战」「反常时刻」是精选片段分类，用来探索不同情境。它们不是随: Daily patterns, Ups and downs, and Surprises are hand-picked categories for exploring different situations. They are not random model evaluation sets, so win rates do not measure overall model performance.
教学情境与真实用电。: Practice scenarios and real electricity use.
循序闯关使用程序生成的模拟能耗。天气预报、设备与出行安排均为教学设定，不是实际气: Practice uses simulated electricity use generated by code. Weather forecasts, equipment and outing plans are teaching settings, not actual weather records. Each scenario is calculated minute by minute, then averaged by hour. An event at 14:30, for example, affects only the second half of 14:00–15:00. When a forecast is uncertain, the reveal explains how the simulated outcome differs from the forecast.

数据来自法国 Sceaux 的一户家庭。原始数据为分钟级记录，这里使用 Glob: The data comes from one household in Sceaux, France. We average the original minute-level Global_active_power readings (active power in kW) by hour. Only continuous windows with complete hours and no missing readings are included.
· 本项目做了小时聚合与片段筛选。: · This project aggregates readings by hour and selects data windows.
保持最后值：所有未来小时等于最后一个历史值。: Last value: every future hour equals the final historical reading.
6 小时均值：所有未来小时等于最近 6 小时平均值。: 6-hour average: every future hour equals the mean of the last 6 hours.
昨日同小时：重复历史最后 24 小时。: Repeat yesterday: repeat the last 24 hours of history.
这些是轻量预测基线，没有经过复杂训练。页面中的「模型」指这三种方法。真实挑战的曲: These are simple forecasting baselines with no complex training. The word “models” on this page refers to these three methods. Real-data challenges use recorded history; practice levels use simulations. The real data has no accompanying weather information, so we do not invent weather explanations for it.
